texts.preamble: Mewa Lal vs State Of U.P. on 18 July, 2019 Author: Chandra Dhari Singh Bench: Chandra Dhari Singh High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench ?Court No. - 28 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 326 of 2008 Revisionist :- Mewa Lal
texts.arguments: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the revisionist has argued only on the sentence. He has submitted that the revisionist has been convicted and sentenced as above. It is also submitted that the revisionist has already undergone sufficient period. He is first time offender, therefore, the present revision may be decided on the basis of period already undergone by the accused-revisionist. Learned Additional Government Advocate vehemently opposed the submissions raised on behalf of the revisionist and submitted that after considering the facts and material on record the Judicial Magistrate, Pratapgarh has rightly convicted the revisionist and awarded appropriate sentence as stated above.
